updates.title_zh: Binance 发布 Agent OS，让 AI 代理在用户授权范围内连接交易和金融服务。
updates.title_en: Binance launched Agent OS to connect AI agents to trading and financial services under user controls.
updates.what_changed_zh: Binance 发布 Agent OS，让 AI 代理在用户授权范围内连接交易和金融服务。
updates.what_changed_en: Binance launched Agent OS to connect AI agents to trading and financial services under user controls.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Binance推出了Agent OS开发者平台，允许AI代理访问市场数据、监控账户并在交易所执行加密货币交易。该平台支持ChatGPT、Claude Code、Codex和Cursor等AI工具，并带有用户配置的权限和限额。 这标志着头部交易所向自主AI驱动交易迈出的重要一步，可能重塑加密货币交易的执行和管理方式。它还加速了AI代理参与链上和金融基础设施的更大趋势，影响交易者、开发者以及AI与加密生态。 用户可以将AI代理分配到专用子账户以隔离资金和活动，随时设置权限或撤销访问。Binance能监控通过Agent OS进行的交易，但看不到代理的外部数据源或决策过程，且该服务不面向欧洲经济区（EEA）用户。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Binance has launched Agent OS, a developer platform that lets AI agents access market data, monitor accounts, and execute crypto trades on the exchange. The platform supports AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor, with user-configured permissions and limits. This marks a major step by a leading exchange toward autonomous AI-driven trading, potentially reshaping how crypto trades are executed and managed. It also accelerates the broader trend of AI agents participating in onchain and financial infrastructure, affecting traders, developers, and the AI-crypto ecosystem. Users can assign agents to dedicated subaccounts to isolate funds and activity, set permissions, and revoke access at any time. Binance can monitor trades placed through Agent OS but cannot see an agent's external data sources or decision-making, and the service is not available to users in the EEA.
